checks.name: agent_oven_local_port_and_render_blueprint
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
vite=Path('products/agent-cloud/app/vite.config.ts').read_text()
blueprint=Path('render.yaml').read_text()
assert '127.0.0.1' in vite and '6670' in vite and vite.count('strictPort: true') == 2
assert 'runtime: static' in blueprint and 'rootDir: products/agent-cloud/app' in blueprint and 'staticPublishPath: ./dist' in blueprint
assert blueprint.count('sync: false') == 3
assert 'type: worker' not in blueprint
